text: CI's gate verifies three projects at a time, after the first runs alone to pull and build the toolchain's images. Verifying every project one after another took 25.7 of a 37-minute gate, while each project's checks run mostly on one core (TLC runs one worker) and GitHub's runner for a public repository has four. The checks and the receipts are the same, and each project's log is shown whole, in order.
